shared_elements: paired forelimbs or paws rendered in shallow relief flanking a central axis
curved beak- or snout-like projection in profile
schematic eyes rendered as simple carved cavities
justification: Both are weathered pale limestone with coarse, schematic low-relief creature anatomy — most specifically a hooked beak/snout profile and a pair of clawed forelimbs held symmetrically against the body, which recurs in both. The decisive difference is format: A is a flat, rectangular slab organised into stacked horizontal registers of profile figures, whereas B is a single volumetric sculpture in the round with the relief subordinated to a rounded, head-like mass.
